No implementation step has started and no project code has changed for this cycle

Upstream scope, design, and context complete and consistent so the only issue is the style request

issues.detail: Assertion 0 concerns the reasoning that the lock starts at approval. It is graded complete only through file state: style tony, lock true, and src/test unchanged. Those checks are necessary for any correct run, and the catalog marked the assertion deterministic_complete, so this is acceptable. A run that preserved the files but gave a wrong explanation would still pass.
issues.fix: None required; optionally make assertion 0 complete:false so the judge also confirms the reply attributes the lock to approval.

summary: The fixture realizes an approved, style-locked (tony), not-yet-started STANDARD development plan in DEVELOPING with a valid style file, a clean check, and no hints in the files or history. All checks are necessary conditions a correct blocking response satisfies: style and lock preserved, no code changes, BlockedOn set, and no cancel, sign-off, or new cycle. The standard invariants are present and fit the case.
